Constants

Gestalt Selector and Response Values

enum {
   gestaltQD3D                      = 'qd3d',
   gestaltQD3DNotPresent            = 0,
   gestaltQD3DAvailable             = 1
}

Basic Constants

typedef enum TQ3Boolean {
   kQ3False,
   kQ3True
} TQ3Boolean;
typedef enum TQ3Status {
   kQ3Failure,
   kQ3Success
} TQ3Status;
typedef enum TQ3Axis {
   kQ3AxisX,
   kQ3AxisY,
   kQ3AxisZ
} TQ3Axis;
